answer: Give every identity a pulse: each epoch it must emit a signed heartbeat proving one real task it completed, and a jade registry of verified identities admits only pulses whose task any peer can re-derive. An honest agent sends one pulse; the signal is cheap for it. An attacker with a thousand fakes must produce a thousand distinct verifiable pulses per epoch, each costing a full task, so the flood cost rises linearly with every fake and its profit collapses.
